title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Implementing the Spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference to Provide Strong Judicial Guarantee for Achieving Next Year's Economic Development Goals
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Seriously Implementing the Spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference to Provide Strong Judicial Guarantees for Achieving Next Year's Economic Development Goals

Fa Fa [2009] No. 57

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The just-concluded Central Economic Work Conference comprehensively analyzed the current international and domestic economic situation, profoundly expounded the importance and urgency of accelerating the transformation of the economic development pattern, and clearly put forward the overall requirements, important principles, and main tasks for next year's economic work. This is of great significance for unifying understanding, pooling strength, and ensuring stable and relatively fast economic development. Earnestly implementing the spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference, fully leveraging the functions of adjudication, and striving to provide strong judicial guarantees for achieving next year's economic development goals are important tasks for the people's courts in the current and upcoming period. To this end, notice is given as follows:

1. Fully recognize the important significance of the Central Economic Work Conference and effectively enhance the consciousness of serving the overall situation.

People's courts at all levels must promptly organize the majority of judicial officers to earnestly study and understand the spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference, deeply recognize the complexity of the situation and the difficulty of doing next year's work well, and effectively unify ideological understanding with the requirements of thoroughly implementing the Scientific Outlook on Development, with the Central Committee's analysis and judgment of the current international and domestic economic situation, and with the guiding ideology and major policies for next year's economic work. This will further enhance the sense of responsibility for serving to maintain stable and relatively fast economic development and transform the economic development pattern. By strengthening the work of law enforcement and case handling, and fully exercising adjudicative functions, strong judicial guarantees shall be provided for achieving next year's economic development goals.

2. Accurately understand and grasp the Central Committee's overall requirements for next year's economic work, and effectively enhance the targeting of judicial policies and work guidance.

People's courts at all levels must take implementing the overall requirements for next year's economic work as the guiding principle for strengthening law enforcement, case handling, and serving economic development. On the basis of deeply understanding and accurately grasping the rich connotations of the "five more emphases" proposed by the Central Economic Work Conference, they shall formulate policy measures for the people's courts to serve economic development. They must fully recognize the new demands that changes in the economic situation place on judicial work, strengthen analysis and judgment of new manifestations of social conflicts in the judicial field under the circumstances of an overall economic rebound, and continue in-depth research on various legal issues arising from the implementation of the proactive fiscal policy and moderately loose monetary policy and their solutions, ensuring that the work of the people's courts always closely revolves around the overall situation of economic development, always subordinates to and serves the overall situation of economic development, and always adapts to the overall situation of economic development.

3. Properly adjudicate various types of cases arising from structural adjustment and domestic demand expansion, and effectively enhance the initiative of serving the transformation of the economic development pattern.

People's courts at all courts must always adhere to active judiciary, effectively enhance political awareness, overall situation awareness, responsibility awareness, and crisis awareness, attach great importance to prominent contradictions and problems involving the judicial field in economic operations, and fully leverage the positive role of active judiciary. They must properly adjudicate and execute various types of disputes, including financial disputes, contract disputes, equity disputes, agriculture-related disputes, foreign trade disputes, and cases concerning intellectual property, energy conservation and emission reduction, enterprise bankruptcy, restructuring and reorganization, etc., that arise in the areas of strengthening macro-control, adjusting economic structure, strengthening work concerning agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, deepening economic reform, promoting export growth, and maintaining social stability. This shall provide good judicial services for winning a comprehensive victory in responding to the impact of the international financial crisis and maintaining stable and relatively fast economic development.

4. Properly adjudicate cases concerning the vital interests of the people, and effectively enhance the steadfastness of safeguarding and serving people's livelihood.

People's courts at all levels must always adhere to the fundamental purpose of justice for the people, continue to carry out the theme practice activity of "People's Judges for the People," and implement the requirements of justice for the people in all work of the people's courts, truly taking valuing people's livelihood, relieving people's worries, and solving people's difficulties as the basis for establishing work ideas, formulating judicial policies, planning judicial reform, and strengthening self-construction. They must further address hot and difficult issues concerning the interests of the people, properly adjudicate cases concerning education, medical care, housing, consumption, employment, as well as food and drug safety, land acquisition and demolition, labor disputes, social security, etc., and strive to protect the legitimate rights and interests of the people; further improve measures to facilitate and benefit the people, promote the experience and practices of remote case filing, circuit trials, appointment-based case handling, establishing "case filing halls," and separating complicated and simple cases, providing warm, considerate, and convenient services to the people; further smooth channels for expressing public opinion and communication, providing favorable conditions for the people and all sectors of society to timely reflect judicial needs.

5. Firmly implement the requirement that stability is a hard task and the primary responsibility, and effectively enhance the initiative of maintaining social stability.

People's courts at all levels must continue to adhere to treating maintaining stability as a hard task and the primary responsibility. They shall further implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity. While strictly cracking down on criminal activities that endanger national security, disrupt social order, infringe upon the interests of the people, undermine market order, and involve corruption and bribery, and intensifying efforts to combat organized crime and root out local mafia, they must also do a good job of education, persuasion, and reclamation work, maximizing the reduction of antagonistic factors and maximizing the increase of harmonious factors. They shall adhere to the principle of "mediation first, combining mediation with adjudication," make efforts to achieve both case resolution and settlement, and fundamentally resolve conflicts. They shall improve the dispute resolution mechanism linking litigation and non-litigation, strengthen coordination with relevant departments, actively participate in comprehensive social management and peace-building activities, work together to resolve social conflicts, and contribute collectively to maintaining harmony and stability.

6. Further strengthen leadership, change work style, and focus on implementation, effectively enhancing the effectiveness of serving economic development.

The party groups of people's courts at all levels must fully play the role of the leadership core, promptly study and resolve major issues in serving economic development. They must go to the grassroots, go deep into reality, strengthen investigation and research, and grasp the initiative in work. They must overcome formalism and bureaucracy, streamline meetings and documents, and focus main energy on grasping work and implementation. They must aim to improve the level of serving the overall situation, use party building to lead team building, use team building to promote adjudication, enhance judicial capabilities, improve judicial style, strengthen integrity construction, and ensure judicial fairness. They must continue to deepen court reform, and ensure healthy work development through sound and complete working mechanisms. All business departments and the majority of judicial officers must, with a strong sense of responsibility, strictly implement the arrangements of higher authorities, actively perform their own duties, make due contributions to achieving next year's economic development goals, and truly fulfill the sacred duties of builders and defenders of the socialist cause with Chinese characteristics.

December 9, 2009
